source.coordinateConvention: Original main-view fine-grid endpoint convention; acquisition XYZ maps to world (x,z,-y).

policy.additionalObjectPurpose: Separately seed the porous and bright core of the same user-selected intraluminal LA object. It was disconnected from the previous exclusion by the wall-protection geodesic rule. Source serial planes and production position readback define these seeds.
policy.distanceMetrics: 3D Euclidean for source support and dense-tissue guard; serial 2D signed-distance envelope interpolation
policy.method: Serial reviewed object envelopes with source-foreground support; source sigma0.5 and sigma0.8 plus raw190 anchored dense tissue protection. Expansion is geodesically connected to the reviewed object and cannot enter isolated wall pockets. Existing v25 atrial exclusions are retained exactly.

Source-derived aortic and pulmonary lumen flood regions selected by reviewed serial seeds, above the valve apparatus; suppress supported interior fragments outside a ten-sample in-plane dense-wall guard. Reject leaky or absent lumen regions.

policy.method: Serial reviewed object envelopes with source-foreground support; source sigma0.5 and sigma0.8 plus raw190 anchored dense tissue protection. Expansion is geodesically connected to the reviewed object and cannot enter isolated wall pockets. The initial particle mask is newly computed v26 source-component cleanup, not an inherited v25 valve exclusion.

detachedPerivalvularParticles.method: Bounded overlapping source slabs. Each 96-sample accepted core has 40 real fine samples of halo, greater than the allowed fragment extent plus retained-tissue guard. Components touching any processing boundary are retained. Only core pixels are committed, avoiding overlap double counts.

tiles.method: 26-connected components of the complete local sigma0.5 source foreground. Only fully interior small candidates are selected; preserve elongated components and all crop-face components. Exact logical-grid mask includes a bounded mesh halo and a wider guard around every retained source component.
